source_snapshot.procedure: Use BMC WebUI to set Always power on, reboot BMC and verify persistence, then while the SUT is off unplug/replug AC and check SUT power status.
source_snapshot.criteria: Policy does not change; Always power on makes the SUT automatically power on after AC returns.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes Redfish PowerRestorePolicy=AlwaysOn set/readback and operator AC work, but omits exact resource discovery, original-policy recovery, verified powered-off precondition, complete feed removal, BMC-reboot persistence and full automatic boot-to-OS-ready evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly treats persistent AlwaysOn, BMC reboot and automatic energization after physical AC restoration as CRITICAL with staged approval and console/health recovery.

old_problem: The policy's standard meaning is known, but a property readback does not prove the system will energize from a verified Off pre-state after real AC loss, nor that the automatic boot reaches OS Ready. Missing outlet/feed identity, maintenance gates, timers and final policy restoration are execution prerequisites, not reasons to keep the engineering decision open.
disposition_reason: DMTF defines ComputerSystem.PowerRestorePolicy=AlwaysOn as powering on when external power is applied. A complete test can therefore preserve three distinct checkpoints—actual WebUI/API setting, persistence after BMC-only reboot, and physical automatic boot after human-controlled full AC removal/restoration—while parameterizing the exact target, feed map, maintenance window and timeouts. Persistent writes, BMC reboot, AC handling and automatic energization remain separately authorized operations.
decision_basis: XLSX row 980, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 981 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 981 / variant fc0866150ffae0af.
DMTF ComputerSystem defines AlwaysOn as the system always powering on when power is applied, providing an authoritative Expected Result without requiring an OEM-specific policy value.

The source explicitly requires a powered-off pre-state. That state, true complete AC loss, automatic PoweringOn/On transition and OS Ready must be individually evidenced; a policy readback or manual power-on would not satisfy it.

AlwaysOn can energize fans, accelerators and attached equipment unexpectedly. Exact feed/outlet scope, personnel clearance, workload safety, console observation and abort/escalation remain mandatory even when the property is standard.

ED-06, ED-08, ED-15, ED-17, ED-18, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve transition identity, actual WebUI/physical evidence, logs and complete OFF-to-ON-to-OS-Ready proof; ED-33 through ED-38 allow Project parameterization but require human AC action, confirmation and no retry.

test_case.test_name: Verify AlwaysOn persistence and automatic complete boot after true AC restoration from host Off
test_case.purpose: Verify AlwaysOn is correctly set in the actual BMC WebUI/approved ComputerSystem property and persists through BMC-only reboot, then from a verified host-Off pre-state causes the exact SUT to energize automatically after a human-controlled complete AC loss/restoration and reach healthy OS Ready without a manual power-on command.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/ComputerSystem/Manager/firmware/WebUI identity and target-advertised writable PowerRestorePolicy with AlwaysOn support
Captured original policy and owner-approved final policy/state, including restoration rules after the test
Complete PSU/feed/PDU/outlet/cable topology proving all feeds needed for genuine external AC loss and excluding neighboring or shared equipment
Verified host-Off and workload-safe precondition plus independent BMC/PowerState/console/POST/OS Ready/service-health observation sources
Maintenance window, personnel/equipment energization clearance, BMC reboot method, per-stage timeouts, AC-off dwell, boot/OS-ready timeout, expected event allowlist and incident runbook
Pinned reviewed Script, protected API/WebUI access, actual rendered WebUI capture, human AC operator/observer and explicit staged approvals
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Discover the exact ComputerSystem and verify advertised AlwaysOn support. Preserve original policy, current power/workload/health, SEL/audit logs and actual rendered WebUI setting. With explicit write approval, set AlwaysOn through the approved protected interface, confirm response/readback and actual WebUI. With separate approval, reboot only the BMC/Manager, wait for full management readiness, rediscover the System and verify AlwaysOn persists. Establish the source-required host-Off pre-state by an approved graceful method, confirm no workload and prove ComputerSystem PowerState Off while recovery observation remains available. A human operator confirms all target/feed/outlet labels, removes every feed required for true AC loss for the approved dwell, records physical/PDU evidence, clears the approved energization area, then restores the same feeds. Without issuing any host power-on command, observe BMC recovery, PowerState progression, console/POST and full OS Ready/service health within approved timeouts. Preserve logs and reconcile expected AC/boot events. Finally, with separate approval, restore the original/final policy and verify final healthy state. Do not substitute BMC reboot, host reboot, DC cycle, one-feed loss or manual power-on; do not automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: AlwaysOn is accepted, read back and shown in the actual WebUI, then remains configured after the BMC-only reboot and management recovery. The SUT is independently proven Off before complete AC loss. After all feeds return, the host automatically progresses from Off through power-on and POST to OS Ready/service health without a manual power-on action, within approved delays, with acceptable health and expected logs only. The approved final policy is restored or explicitly retained and the platform finishes healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target/property discovery, original-policy capture, protected AlwaysOn write/readback, actual WebUI evidence, persistence after distinct BMC reboot, verified Off/workload-safe pre-state, human proof of complete AC loss/restoration, automatic power-on with no manual trigger, full OFF-to-ON-to-OS-Ready/health evidence, log reconciliation and final policy restoration. API/WebUI readback, a BMC reboot, host reboot, DC cycle, single-feed interruption, PowerState On without OS Ready or manual boot cannot pass. Failure to auto-start, wrong target/feed, unexpected event, boot timeout or recovery/policy failure is FAIL. Missing runtime bindings makes execution NOT READY, not Pending.
safety_gate: Require separate explicit approval immediately before the policy write, BMC reboot, host-off preparation and physical AC removal/restoration; reverify the exact target at every gate.
Physical AC handling is human-only. Confirm all target feeds and exclude shared/neighbor outlets; the agent must not operate cords/PDU or assume one PSU interruption equals AC loss.
Prove the host is Off and workloads are drained before AC removal, and clear personnel/equipment hazards before enabling AlwaysOn auto-energization.
Capture original policy and tested recovery/console paths before mutation; actual WebUI and API must agree and the automatic boot must not be assisted by a manual power command.
Preserve SEL, audit, PDU, console and OS evidence; do not clear logs or mask expected AC/boot events.
Stop on wrong target/outlet, incomplete isolation, write/persistence error, lost observation channel, unsafe energization, alarm or boot anomaly; never automatically retry a power cycle.
expected_evidence: Staged approvals, immutable System/Manager/PDU/feed identity, original policy and verified Off/workload/energization-safe baseline
Protected AlwaysOn write/readback metadata and actual rendered WebUI setting before and after BMC reboot
BMC-only reboot/recovery milestones, System rediscovery and persisted policy evidence
Human operator/PDU proof of complete AC loss/dwell/restoration with exact feeds and timestamps
No-manual-trigger automatic PowerState/console/POST/OS Ready/service-health timeline and expected-versus-observed logs
Restored or explicitly retained final policy, final health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If automatic power-on or boot/health recovery is abnormal, stop further power actions and keep feeds in the owner-approved safe state. Use the predefined console/BMC/PDU incident procedure; do not issue repeated cycles. Once stable and separately authorized, restore the captured original/final policy and recover OS/services, preserving all evidence and escalating failures without automatic retry.

source_conflict.reason: Master consistently requires AlwaysOn persistence and automatic power-on after AC restoration from Off. DeepSeek is directionally aligned but incomplete.

blocked.reason: DMTF supplies the property and expected behavior. Exact feed topology, maintenance, timeouts and recovery are bounded Project execution inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Actual System/Manager/property support; original/final policy; complete feed/PDU map; verified Off/workload/energization-safe precondition; BMC/AC/boot/OS timers; event allowlist; WebUI/Script/console/recovery runbook.

project_authority: The Project owner binds the standard policy to the exact System/Manager, full AC feed topology, safe auto-energization and boot/OS recovery rules. These finite inputs make the hybrid test review-complete without changing its critical execution controls.
